**Priority Matrix** is a private, offline Eisenhower matrix in a single HTML file. You sort tasks into four boxes by urgency and importance, put each box in order, and work through them. There's no account, no server and no tracking: your tasks stay in your browser.

This is the first public release.

### Get started

1. Under **Assets** below, download **Priority-Matrix-1.0.0.html**.
2. Open it in your browser. There's nothing to install, and it works without an internet connection.

You can also use it online at https://lonelysoul87.github.io/priority-matrix/ (always the latest version).

### What it does

**Deciding.** Each box says what to do with its tasks: Do now, Delegate or batch, Schedule, Drop. Optional due dates let urgency follow the clock. An Inbox lets you capture first and sort later, one key per task.

**Doing.** Each box is a ranked list. Move cards by dragging their grip, with the Move menu, or with the keyboard. Tasks can have steps, details with links, labels, and a repeat.

**Staying safe.** Undo for everything, with a visible Undo bar. Done and Discarded trays keep finished and dropped tasks. One-click backups, with a reminder when one is due. Saved data the app can't read is kept aside instead of being overwritten, and two open tabs never erase each other's work.

**Fitting you.** 40 themes in light and dark, plus your own. Column or list view, a phone layout and a clean print layout. Press ? in the app for every keyboard shortcut.

### Your data

Everything stays in the browser you use it in. Each browser keeps its own board, and clearing a browser's site data clears it, so download a backup now and then. A backup also moves your board to another browser or device. The online version and a downloaded file count as different places, so each keeps its own board.

### Coming from an earlier copy

If you used a private development build (up to 1.11.2), download a backup there first, close its tab, then open 1.0.0. Older backups restore normally.

The [README](https://github.com/LonelySoul87/priority-matrix/blob/v1.0.0/README.md) has the keyboard shortcuts and details, and the [release notes](https://github.com/LonelySoul87/priority-matrix/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) list everything new since the development builds.
